## Support for Multi-Finger Swipe Gestures


With our latest release, we’ve introduced support for **multi-finger swipe gestures** on mobile devices. You can now perform swipe gestures using up to three fingers, enabling more complex mobile interactions.


To use this feature, simply specify the number of fingers in your swipe command, as shown below:


```text
swipe right with 2 fingers
```


```text
swipe right with 3 fingers
```


This functionality is available for mobile testing only.
